corpus_manifest.description: Curated corpus contract for Upgrade-v2 trust architecture evidence. The current entries include registered local H.264 assets plus a small external CC0 H.264 derivative used for promotion-gate sanity checks.
corpus_manifest.claim_scope: local H.264 corpus plus external CC0 seed corpus

entries.selection: all existing registered local H.264 assets

derivation.command: ffmpeg -i mdn_flower.mp4 -vf scale=352:288,fps=30 -frames:v 30 -an -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -coder 0 -g 1 -qp 22 mdn_flower_cif_q22_g1_30f.h264
derivation.purpose: small reproducible H.264 baseline/CAVLC diagnostic fixture

promotion_requirements: Add non-local or externally curated real-video assets.
Record source, license, codec/container, resolution, frame count, and hash for every external asset.
Keep local, synthetic, and external-public metrics separated in output JSON.
Do not claim broad public-dataset robustness from the seed corpus alone; broad claims require a larger external corpus.

c2pa_anchor.evidence: 32-byte manifest root payload roundtrip and tamper detection

fingerprint_local_registry.evidence: registered local H.264 corpus threshold sweep

fingerprint_external_corpus.evidence: external corpus fingerprint decode and threshold sanity

watermark_receipt.evidence: keyed-template detector with resynchronized stress matrix

tee_attestation.evidence: canonical bundle signing and sidecar roundtrip

ready_workflows.evidence: src.trust.workflows facade covers provenance, fingerprint, watermark, and attestation

zk_circuits.evidence: fingerprint and detector receipt circuits compile and Groth16 verify
